question: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill 2023 aims to make the _____________ only conclusive age proof that can be used as a single document for various purposes.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Birth Certificate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill 2023** aims to streamline the process of using a **Birth Certificate** as the only conclusive age proof.
 
• A **Birth Certificate** will serve as a single document for various purposes such as **admission to educational institutions, issuing of driving licenses, passports, and Aadhaar cards**.
 
• This amendment will help in reducing the need for multiple documents and simplify administrative procedures.
 
• The bill aims to create a more **efficient and reliable system** for managing and verifying age-related information.
 
• A **centralized database** will be created to maintain the records, ensuring better coordination and accessibility.
 
• This measure will also aid in the prevention of **identity fraud** and ensure that individuals have a single, official document that can be universally accepted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ST/SC/OBC Certificate**__

 __
 
• These certificates are issued to individuals belonging to specific **Scheduled Tribes (ST), Scheduled Castes (SC), and Other Backward Classes (OBC)** to avail reservations and benefits under government schemes.
 
• They are not used as age proof but rather for verifying eligibility for various social and educational benefits.
 
 
 
• **Aadhar Card**__
 __
 
• The **Aadhar Card** is a unique identification number issued to residents of India by the **Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)**.
 
• While it contains demographic and biometric data, it is not specifically designed as a conclusive age proof.
 
 
 
• **Voter ID**__
 
 
• The **Voter ID** is issued by the **Election Commission of India** to adult citizens of India for the purpose of voting.
 
• It serves as an identity proof but is not primarily used for age verification.
